The G1 frontmatter gate, now watching src/

Ports hq-ext-plugin #1983 + #1990 into orchestkit CI: a standards registry (configs/standards.json) holding the allowed frontmatter keys, and an advisory check (scripts/check-frontmatter.py) that judges a PR using the base-branch gate code with the head checked out as data only. It scans src/ only - plugins/ is a build output of the same files. The ratchet baseline carries every pre-existing key (the taskTypes/keywords/examplePrompts generation included), so only a NEW non-spec key reports.

Trust model: three checkouts, one reader

trustedgithub.shabase branch tip. The workflow YAML and every program run come from here.
basepull_request.base.shaconfigs only. The floor: allowlists + baseline the PR is judged by.
headpull_request.head.shafull tree, data only. Never executed, sourced, installed, or used as cwd.

Why pull_request_target

Under pull_request the PR supplies its own copy of the gate, so a PR could turn the check green by editing check-frontmatter.py or moving a house key into the allowlist in the same commit. The verdict workflow takes its code from the base branch; the head contributes bytes, not programs. A loosened allowlist or a raised baseline fails as its own class of finding (WIDENED, GROWN), even though the run is advisory.

What a verdict reports

stepfails when the head...code
allowlist wideningallows a key the floor did not, drops a required key, raises a limit, changes the name patternWIDENED
file scancarries a violation code absent from the floor baseline for that fileNEW
baseline ratchetrecords codes the base branch baseline did not (add debt + record it, one commit)GROWN
input hygienesymlinks a gate config, SKILL.md or agent fileexit 2

Advisory, by construction

Both jobs run continue-on-error: true and neither is a required context: a red verdict surfaces as ::warning annotations plus a job summary table, never as a blocking check. The companion workflow standards-gate-head.yml runs the PR's own self-tests (--self-test: 21 planted controls, plus both shell suites: 31 + 6 checks) so a change to the gate is exercised before merge.

Evidence in this worktree: self-test ok (21 planted controls + 2 clean registries) · base-trust 31/31 · base-ratchet 6/6 · actionlint clean · shellcheck clean.
